name: Week 29 Pull — Short, and the Curl Goes 25 Both Sides
description:
**The short third day.** Chest-supported row, reverse fly and cable crunch stay out so it keeps its length.

**Incline curl runs 25 on both arms.** The split is gone — the left took 25 for every set last week, four weeks after failing halfway through the first set at that load. **A light bicep set goes in before the pull-ups** so the tendon is not walking into a loaded stretch cold.

**Pull-ups are plain bodyweight**, 4 sets, 3s eccentric. Log the numbers and leave them alone. **The high cable curl ladder climbs to 210 → 220 → 230 → 240**, and **DB row holds the 75 → 85 → 95 pyramid** with the grip as the honest ceiling.

dayOverview.theme: Repeat a shape that works, with two changes: the incline curl runs 25 on both arms, and a light bicep set goes in front of the pull-ups so the elbow is warm before anything hangs off it. The cable curl ladder climbs; everything else holds.

spotlights.why: The left took 25 for every set last week — the best result since the problem started — and it is also the only lift where the tendon spot shows up. Warm it first and find out whether 25 both sides repeats.

dayOverview.rotationPlan: W30 — spotlight moves to the DB row and the left-side grip ceiling. W31 — lat pulldown and the chest-supported row return when the week stops being short.
watchpoints: 🛑 keep it shy — the cue is the cap: pull-ups, DB row, lat pulldown, incline curl. Grip and position lifts where the honest ceiling is the rep the cue breaks.
🔥 near-failure last set OK: face pull, high cable curl. Isolation work where form holds at the limit.

**New this week: one light bicep set before the pull-up bar.** The tendon spot on the left sits at the elbow, and the day currently walks from a passive dead hang — elbows locked out, tendon on stretch, cold — straight into loaded pull-ups. Warm it first.
**Incline curl is 25 both arms.** No split, left first. If the left cannot hold form at 25, drop that arm for the day rather than grinding it.
**Pull-ups are not a test.** Three weeks at 8 / 6 / 6 is the shape a bodyweight lift makes during a bulk. Write the numbers, do not chase them.
**Band-pull-apart is the pull-day shoulder anchor.** Keep the warmup lean — no extra band volume on a day that already runs long.

sets.name: Warmup (Pull-Up Bar Station) + Bicep Pre-Load
sets.notes: Lean by design — legs sat between this day and push, so the shoulders come in rested. The new piece is the bicep set at the end: it is there so the elbow is warm before it takes bodyweight.

exercises.notes: **The shoulder anchor for pull day.** Light band, slow, squeeze the blades together without shrugging.
Passive hang. **Also your first read on the right shoulder today** — note whether it is quiet.

**New — light DBs, nowhere near failure.** The dead hang above puts the bicep tendon on stretch with the elbow locked out; this puts blood through it before the bar takes your bodyweight. **Left side first.**
**Protective activation — do this before anything loaded.** 40-50lb pair, behind the back, straight up and down, squeeze at the top.

sets.name: Pull-Ups — Straight Bar, 4 Sets, 3s Eccentric 🛑
sets.notes:
Bodyweight, 4 sets to form failure, **3s eccentric on every rep.** Straight bar.

- The set ends when the tempo breaks or the shoulders shrug up
- **Log all four numbers without chasing them**
- Three sets is a fine answer if the shoulder is talking

exercises.notes:
Bodyweight, 4 sets, **3s eccentric every rep.** Straight bar.
- Pack down before the elbows bend
- Set ends when the tempo breaks
- Write the numbers, leave them alone

sets.name: 🔆 DB Rack / Bench Block — Incline Curl → DB Row (3 Rounds)
sets.notes:
Both live at the adjustable benches — set up once and stay there.

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT: incline curl at 25 both arms.**
- **Bench at 45°, arms hanging fully behind the body** — the stretch at the bottom is the entire reason for the incline
- **Left arm first**, and the left sets the rep count
- **Do not swing the shoulder forward** to start the rep
- Slow eccentric, full extension at the bottom, and arrive at the stretch rather than dropping into it
- If the left cannot hold form at 25, stop that arm for the day — do not grind it back to 20 mid-set

**Reflection:** did 25 hold on the left for all three sets, and did the tendon spot show up at all after warming it first?

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 25lb both arms, 3 sets of 10 each side. **Left first.**
- 45° bench, arms hanging **behind** the body
- No shoulder swing to start
- Slow eccentric, full extension
- Arrive at the bottom stretch, do not drop into it

**LOAD:** pyramid **75 → 85 → 95**, one set each side.
- **Chest supported on the bench**, spine long, no twisting to finish
- **Elbow drives back past the ribs**, not out to the side
- Slow eccentric, full stretch at the bottom
- **The left will end around 7-8 on the 95 — that is the grip-limited number and it is the honest one.** No straps

sets.name: Lat Pulldown — 160 🛑
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** regular machine **160** · cable pulley **70/side**. **Log which.**

- **Pack the shoulders DOWN before the elbows move** — blades into the back pockets first
- Bar to the collarbones, chest up
- **Slow eccentric** — that is where 160 used to get difficult
- Ribs down, no leaning back to finish

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** regular machine **160** · cable pulley **70/side**. Log which.

- Bar to the collarbones, chest up
- Slow eccentric, ribs down

sets.name: Face Pull — 62.5 🔥
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** 62.5, 3 sets of 20.

The third set has cost something two weeks running — that is the load sitting in the right place, not a reason to move it.

- **Hands finish beside the ears**, elbows high
- **Rotate the knuckles back** at the end of every rep
- Hold a beat, slow return
- Traps quiet

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 62.5.
- Hands finish beside the ears, elbows high
- **Knuckles rotate back** at the end of the rep
- Hold a beat, slow return, traps quiet

sets.name: High Cable Curl — 210 → 220 → 230 → 240 🔥
sets.notes:
**LOAD:** cable column **210 / 220 / 230 / 240** ascending · single pulley **62.5**. **Log which.**

190 and 200 stopped doing work, so the ladder starts higher and keeps climbing. 220 read *hard-ish* last week — the rungs above it are meant to be short.

- **Single arm**, cable high, elbow fixed in space
- **Do not let the elbow drift forward** — the upper arm stays put
- Squeeze at the top, slow return to full extension
- **A short top set is the ladder working, not a miss**

sets.name: Cool-Down — 5 Min Fascia/Recovery Block
sets.notes: Five minutes, every gym day. Slow breathing throughout — the downshift is as much the point as the tissue.

exercises.notes: 30s each arm, elbow at MID height.
Passive. Let the shoulders decompress after the pulling.

tips: The light bicep set before the pull-ups is new — it is warmup, not work.
Incline curl is 25 both arms this week. Left first, and the left sets the reps.
No straps on the row. The left stopping around 7-8 at 95 is the honest number.
Cable curl starts at 210 now. A short top set is the point of a ladder.
Pull-up numbers get written down, not chased.
